FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor performance improvement
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Prevents unnecessary re-computation of designed mercenaries every time the main window is closed.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a call to ChangeTick in CheckMilitaryUtilForErrors, allowing existing guards to exit early
Update a couple of tests to reflect recent tweaking of mechanics

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor pawnkind fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor change to pawnkind fallback when generating mercs.

patchNoteLines.li: Use PColony_Fighter pawnkind as a fallback when generating mercenarys instead of calling RandomPawnKind

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: SettlementDef update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the WorldSettlementDef to make it easier to modify building progression.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds baseUnlockedBuildings and perLevelUnlockedBuildings fields to WorldSettlementDef. The number of buildings unlocked at any given level is baseUnlockedBuildings + Floor(perLevelUnlockedBuildings * settlement level)
